Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Ridgeside Village 16 NPC Portraits
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portraits of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] 16 NPCs, Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait.

Including beach portraits.

09/05/2021: Added extra portrait for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/7439530]zoedoll[/url]'s character [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9375]Leilani (NPC for Ridgeside Village)[/url].


[size=3]The NPCs included in this pack:[b] [/b][/size][size=3][b]Aguar, [/b][/size][size=3][b]Bert, Ezekiel, Freddie, Helen, Jio, Keahi, Kiwi, Lenny, Lola, Olga, Pika, Richard, Trinnie, Undreya, Yuuma.[/b][/size]

Drag the folders ( [CP] Ridgeside Village, [STF] Ridgeside Village ) into Stardew Valley\Mods\Ridgeside Village Mod folder to replace the original ( [CP] Ridgeside Village, [STF] Ridgeside Village ) folder for it to work, it replaces all those 16 character's default portraits. 

Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ mod.)
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]

Uploaded CP version.
*I would still recommend the replacement file version as the assets don't get loaded 2 times and are lighter to run.

Uploaded [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] version.
For people who prefer to install them in Portraiture or having people disappearing issues in 64bit version game.



All characters belong to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.

Leilani belongs to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9375]Leilani (NPC for Ridgeside Village)[/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/7439530]zoedoll[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
